results.comment: I’ve been hearing Linus talk about this for so many weeks on the WAN show, so happy to finally be able to watch it!! Looking forward to a great vid!  Edit: So awesome vid and very informative! Been watching a long time and have built two PCs so far and I feel like I know a lot, I still learned quite a bit from this video. I think it was really well done and explained and will be very helpful to a new viewer or first time PC builder. I wish there would have been more links though in video. I noticed a lot of times that you were using clips from your old videos and do see the names of them in the top black bar but would have been nice to have small pop ups for viewers to click on later if they wanted a more in depth look at some of these topics. Or even the part when Linus snapped his fingers 1:37:52 saying you can find out more here, and then nothing popped up to click on. Like this would basically function as a build video that can branch off for the viewer as needed. Other than that great work and really enjoyed it overall! You all should be proud 😀
